title: The Carbon Isotopic Ratio and Planet Formation
question: What is the 12C/13C ratio in C2H in the TW Hya disk, does it differ from that in CO, and can thermochemical models with isotopic fractionation produce two separate carbon isotopic reservoirs?

evidence.quote: We refer the reader to the original article for details on the data reduction and imaging.

what.value: Other TW Hya 12C/13C ratios (Zhang17, Hily-Blant19, Yoshida24)

recipe.method: Keplerian-masked moment-0 map; integrated over disk and annulus 0.52-1.68 arcsec; uncertainties following Teague19
key_parameters: i=6.8 deg, PA=151 deg, Mstar=0.6 Msun, d=60.1 pc

recipe.method: Shift spectra by Keplerian velocity, stack in annuli 0.52-1.68 arcsec weighted by area, integrate
key_parameters: Annulus width 1/4 beam FWHM (~80 mas); weights proportional to r^2; centre offset (-52, -155) mas

recipe.method: Ratio of integrated flux (and peak) densities, assuming optically thin, correcting 11% A-coefficient difference
DALI late-stage and early-stage disk models with isotope network, vertical cuts at 63 au
key_parameters: zeta 1e-19 (late) vs 5e-17 s-1 (early); small-grain fraction 1% vs 10%; run 1 Myr; initial 12C/13C 77
assumptions: C/O ~2 late-stage, half of gas carbon in CH4; early stage ISM CO 2.7e-4

evidence.quote: yields an integrated flux of $56.9 \pm 14.1~{\rm mJy~km\,s^{-1}}$
we find a C$_2$H / $^{13}$CCH ratio of $74 \pm 22$ in the bright annulus

answer_key.quantity: Model CO 12C/13C at 63 au, late stage

evidence.quote: The gaseous CO isotopic ratio estimated from column density ratios at 63 au is 79
The gaseous C$_2$H isotopic ratio estimated from column density ratios is 78

not_stated_but_needed: Image size, cell size, deconvolver, threshold and masking for CLEAN of 13CCH
Line-free channels used for self-calibration and solint
Rest frequencies and hyperfine line parameters
Velocity integration limits for line fluxes
Full DALI chemical network files and grid setup
score_reason: Data public and extraction method clear, but imaging details and DALI setup rely on prior papers.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, stacking recipe described, numeric flux and ratio results.
